task: BR-05 (dialogs answered and reported; approved confirm answers)

files.changes: one listener on the whole context answers every dialog as it opens, never holding one: alert, confirm and prompt are dismissed; beforeunload is accepted (as Playwright does by default; dismissing it would cancel an approved navigation); during an approved action only, a confirm whose message is exactly the approved one is accepted once; the kind, the opening page's URL and a cleaned (no lone surrogates, controls or invisible characters), bounded, single-line message are logged (at most 8 between reads); unknown kinds are dismissed and only counted

files.adapted: take_dismissed_dialogs; the dialogs frame; form_binding/form_action accept_confirm
files.changes: new code: the host reads and clears the log, checks kinds and bounds, refuses control, bidi and format characters, and returns URLs and messages as untrusted PageText; an approved confirm is part of the form action's approval state (accept-confirm and the exact message), learned from a first, dismissed attempt

authority_delta: Dialogs are answered explicitly: alert, confirm and prompt 'no' (Playwright's default), beforeunload 'yes' (Playwright's default, so an approved navigation still leaves the page). New: during an approved form action, a confirm with exactly the approved message is answered 'yes', once; the approval binds that message.
residuals: The report names the page that opened the dialog, not the frame; a dialog from a cross-origin frame is attributed to its page.
Answering a prompt with text, and accepting confirms during link activations, downloads or WebMCP execution, are not offered (form actions only).
The backlog's interface (a dialog_respond frame, tabs list/select/close) is not followed: dialogs are answered as they open and approved confirms are armed per action; tabs remain a follow-up.
